title: Умовні речення
rule: Zero: if + Present, Present (факти): If you heat ice, it melts. First: if + Present, will (реальне майбутнє): If the tests pass, we will deploy. Second: if + Past, would (нереальне теперішнє): If I were you, I would ask. Third: if + Past Perfect, would have + V3 (минуле): If we had written tests, we would have found the bug. Після if (і when, unless, as soon as) НІКОЛИ не став will/would.

items.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___.
items.explanation: Zero conditional: загальний факт — Present Simple в обох частинах.

items.prompt: If the tests ___, we will deploy tonight.
items.explanation: У First conditional після if стоїть Present Simple, а не will.

items.prompt: If I ___ more money, I would buy a new laptop.
items.explanation: Second conditional: if + Past Simple, у головній частині would.

items.prompt: If we had written tests, the bug ___ production.
items.explanation: Third conditional: головна частина — would have + V3.

items.prompt: I'll call you as soon as I ___ home.
items.explanation: Після as soon as про майбутнє вживаємо Present Simple, не will.

items.prompt: Unless you ___ the config, the app won't start.
items.explanation: Unless уже має негативне значення, тому дієслово стоїть у стверджувальній формі.

items.prompt: If I ___ you, I would ask for a code review.
items.explanation: У Second conditional після if вживаємо were (для I/he/she теж).

items.prompt: What would you do if you ___ your job tomorrow?
items.explanation: Second conditional: після if — Past Simple, а would лише в головній частині.

items.prompt: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have started earlier.
items.explanation: Інверсія в Third conditional: Had I known = If I had known.

items.prompt: If you ___ any questions, just ask me.
items.explanation: Після if ставимо Present Simple, не will.

items.prompt: If I ___ (be) you, I would not merge this branch.
items.explanation: Нереальна умова: після if вживаємо were (розмовне was теж можливе).

items.prompt: If we ___ (not / fix) this bug, the client will be angry.
items.explanation: First conditional: після if — Present Simple.

items.prompt: If I had left earlier, I ___ (not / miss) the train.
items.explanation: Third conditional: would not have + V3.

items.prompt: She ___ (help) you if you asked her.
items.explanation: Second conditional: if + Past Simple, would + інфінітив.

items.prompt: If you ___ (not / save) your work, it disappears when the power goes out.
items.explanation: Zero conditional: загальна істина — Present Simple.

items.prompt: Unless he ___ (apologise), I won't talk to him.
items.explanation: Після unless — Present Simple, не will.

items.prompt: If I will have time tomorrow, I will help you.
answers: If I have time tomorrow, I will help you.
items.explanation: Після if не вживаємо will — тільки Present Simple.

items.prompt: If I would be you, I would take that offer.
answers: If I were you, I would take that offer.
If I was you, I would take that offer.
items.explanation: Після if не ставимо would; потрібне were/was.

items.prompt: If he would have asked me, I would have helped.
answers: If he had asked me, I would have helped.
items.explanation: У Third conditional після if потрібен Past Perfect, а не would have.

items.prompt: When the build will finish, I will send you the link.
answers: When the build finishes, I will send you the link.
When the build finishes, I'll send you the link.
items.explanation: Після when про майбутнє вживаємо Present Simple.
